seoTitle: Text Repeater: Repeat a Word or Line Many Times
metaDescription: Repeat any text up to 100,000 times with a separator of your choice: space, new line, comma or custom. Handy for test data.
intro: Create long repeated strings for testing, fill-in text or formatting experiments.
why:
Enter the text, the number of repetitions and a separator. Use \n and \t in the custom separator for line breaks and tabs. The result is limited to five million characters to keep your browser responsive.

For realistic placeholder text use the lorem ipsum or random text generators instead.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Type or paste the text to repeat.
Use shorter counts for quick tests.

faq.a: 100,000 repetitions or five million characters, whichever comes first.

faq.q: How do I repeat with new lines?
Is it useful for load tests?
faq.a: It can create large payloads, but dedicated tools suit real load testing.
No. Everything is processed in your browser, and the page makes no network requests with your input.
